text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen… What do you think, Trainer? Shall we take a look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's have you-know-who show me how to really run under pressure!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Here come today's racers. First, we have Mejiro Ryan. Next, the glass princess who runs unwaveringly despite her frail condition, Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They're here today to represent the Mejiro family, but we have another Umamusume to look out for as well.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Presenting the superstar racer who built a new era…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: That's right, it's Oguri Cap! She hasn't quite been herself her past few races, but I wonder what kind of run we'll see from her today!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Oguri! We're counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Don't push yourself anymore… Just take the day to rest…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa… What's going on? It's like a mess of pure hope mixed with pure sympathy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's almost too much just listening to it… I can't believe anyone can run under pressure like that.
choice_data_list: Yeah. I'm sure it can't be easy.
Yeah. I'm sure it can't be easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It feels like we're witnessing a very special race, one where the whole country is watching—like a special moment in Umamusume history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only is she not in top form, but she's also under immense pressure. Despite all these obstacles, Oguri Cap rises to the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Oguri Cap! Oguri! Oguri! Oguriii!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's made her comeback at the Arima Kinen! What a dramatic turn of events! It's a real miracle!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Thanks for showing us the dream, Oguri Cap, and for a moving performance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No way… She did it… She actually won…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And in such a convoluted situation too! No way! That's… wild…

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: O-GU-RI! O-GU-RI!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What we're looking at…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Is a true role model. A super Umamusume who defies all the odds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I just wanna ask you something! You know how you had all that pressure on you? Um…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Weren't you nervous or scared? You didn't really look affected by everything that was going on around you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pressure? Well… I know the fans expect a lot from me. But…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't really know much about being nervous or scared… I don't have time for that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The only thing I gotta do is live up to people's expectations. That's what I always want to do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: They put their faith in me, and I run for them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Faith and expectations, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (No kidding… So there's really someone who can take pressure like that and turn it into power.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap… Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Is that what it means to run freely?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer has learned something huge. After, we see everyone else mulling over their respective challenges.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Dang, second place. I couldn't outmuscle Oguri… I gotta figure out how to unlock my body's full potential!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I let everyone down. Oguri and I were in the same post, and she won. This just proves I am still missing resolve…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Huh, so we're all the same… Although, they might be on a different level than I am…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Still, everyone's carrying something. And everyone's grasping for what they want despite that…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I realized something watching the race today. I've still got a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I realized something else, too! Every single person in the Twinkle Series is carrying some kind of burden.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm not the only one. So…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Next year, I'm gonna make sure I'm strong enough not to let the pressure get the best of me! Just like Oguri Cap!
